PluginData.Tooltip: Pick blocks, see the missing components against your storage and order them in one go.
PluginData.Description: Plan a build and order its parts. Pick blocks, see which components are missing against your storage, check for ore deficits and broken conveyor links, then order the rest from your crafters. Version 0.1.0.1 is an early test build (log output only).
